channel.title: BrightBytes.dev
channel.description: Practical notes on embedded Linux, electronics, and building software. Tutorials and projects by Ahmad Roshanfar.

item.title: Building SceneSense for Raspberry Pi with Yocto, kas, and an SDK
item.description: How I packaged SceneSense as a Raspberry Pi Linux system, with pinned Yocto layers, a kiosk interface, and a matching application SDK.

item.title: Qt Connectivity BLE: A Reusable Bluetooth Layer for Linux
item.description: How I separated Linux Bluetooth discovery, asynchronous pairing, and GATT transport from application UI and device-specific protocols.

item.title: SceneSense: GoPro Control and Live Object Detection with Qt Quick
item.description: How I built a Qt Quick camera workstation with GoPro control, live video, local object detection, and an embedded Linux deployment path.

item.title: EPaper Image Generator GUI
item.description: Build a Qt workflow for preparing photos and sending them to a Raspberry Pi e-paper display over SSH.

item.title: Getting Started with Flutter on Embedded Linux
item.description: Understand the Dart, Flutter engine, and Linux display layers, then run a sample with flutter-elinux.

item.title: Deploying a Gatsby Site on GitHub Pages
item.description: See how BrightBytes turns MDX and React into a static blog, then preview, build, and publish it with Gatsby.
